title: Working with Culturally and Linguistically Diverse Communities
description: This module supports practitioners to work safely and respectfully with people from culturally and linguistically diverse (CALD) backgrounds. It focuses on cultural humility, migration-related barriers, and safe, trauma-informed engagement.
outcomes: Understand how culture, migration, and language shape DFV experiences
Apply culturally safe and trauma-informed approaches
Engage CALD communities respectfully and effectively
